name: Veggie Ground Shepherd's Pie with Mixed Vegetables & Potato Topping
ingredients: 20 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place potatoes in a medium saucepan and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are fork-tender, 10-12 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel and mince onion; peel, trim, and small dice carrots.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add the onion and carrot. Cook, stirring frequently, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.

When the veggies are soft, add veggie ground to the skillet, along with half of the parsley and spices (reserving remaining parsley for garnish). Cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until crumbly and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
While the veggie ground is cooking, preheat oven to broil on high.
When the veggie ground is done, add garlic and soy sauce to the skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 1 minute.

Add flour and tomato paste to the skillet; stir well, then add broth, peas, and corn. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until thickened, about 5 minutes.
When the potatoes are done, drain and return to the saucepan. Add broth, oil, garlic powder, and salt; mash with a potato masher until smooth.
Transfer the veggie ground mixture to a baking dish and spread evenly; top with mashed potatoes. Place in the oven and broil for 2-3 minutes, until the potatoes begin to brown.
To serve, divide the Shepherd's pie between plates and garnish with remaining parsley. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
